text: to commune: Heb. a word | who can withold himself from speaking? Heb. who can refrain from words?
the feeble knees: The bowing knees
came upon me: Heb. met me | all my bones: Heb. the multitude of my bones
there was silence: Or, I heard a still voice
and his Angels he charged: Or, nor in his Angels, in whom he put light
